summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Sahkan v1. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests pass (OTP owner/authority login, admin login, institutions, submit pipeline, Merkle docHash, duplicate 409, PDF validation, authority queue/blob/decide, atomic double-decide 409, blob wipe 410, admin pending authorities approve, audit chain validity, role guards, logout). Frontend Playwright: landing hero + CTA, OWNER OTP login, document submit with result panel (docHash/chunks/scan chips), /owner/dokumen list, AUTHORITY OTP login + queue, review workbench with pdf-canvas-container + metadata, approve dialog + ECDSA signature panel, new AUTHORITY sees 'Menunggu persetujuan admin' pending screen, ADMIN password login, pending-authorities-table approve, audit chain page with valid indicators + pagination, unauth /owner -> /login, OWNER /admin -> /owner (cross-role guard). Only one UI test (reject flow) hit a stale form state when re-submitting from same page after cookie clear; the underlying reject-requires-reason logic is verified in backend pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfig: server.py sets allow_credentials=True together with allow_origins=* (falls back to env CORS_ORIGINS='*'). Browsers will reject credentialed responses from wildcard origin. It works today only because frontend uses same-origin (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to the ingress host). Recommend an explicit origin list for production.
server.py is 786 lines and mixes auth, crypto, submit, decide, admin, and seeding — should be split into modules (auth.py, documents.py, admin.py, crypto.py, seed.py) once past MVP.

Frontend Login and OwnerSubmit trigger a React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). This is caused by dev-instrumentation attributes (x-file-name / data-ve-dynamic) injected into <option> children, not by app code. Harmless in production but noisy in dev console.
PdfViewer worker is loaded from cdnjs (external dependency). If CDN is blocked the review page silently degrades — consider bundling the worker.
OTP session lookup in /auth/otp/verify picks the latest un-verified session by createdAt but does not include an index on (email, purpose, createdAt). Add compound index for scale.
